conclusion: The only newly identified mechanism not explicitly named in the repository closure is SART/LayerABS. It is mathematically distinct but statically inadmissible under the active goal. No other public 2025-2026 method supplies a root-only deterministic primal mechanism with evidence for both target families while avoiding the prohibited method classes.

gurobi_preflight.fact: The installed restricted Gurobi license rejects a synthetic 2001-variable model with error 10010, before either target model is loaded.

sart_static_admissibility_audit.official_claimed_role: Reduce binary variables in complete ReLU verification through sign-absolute reformulation and progressive LayerABS tightening.
sart_static_admissibility_audit.pure_sart_solver_sessions: A new paired min/max Gurobi model is created and optimized for each bound query, repeated per neuron and per layer.
sart_static_admissibility_audit.implemented_result_data: ObjVal or ObjBound intervals only; the layerabs tree contains no incumbent input extraction through Attr.X, .X, or getVars().

target_family_evidence.official_variants: MNIST, VNNCOMP-ERAN MNIST, and small fully connected CIFAR-10 networks

prohibition_collisions: exact SART uses MIP and its internal branch-and-bound
LayerABS is a staged fallback pipeline
per-neuron paired bound solves are not one root solve
no ACT-authorizable input witness is produced

sart_phase_projection_math_fit.current_owner_solver: one deterministic HiGHS instance pinned to simplex
sart_phase_projection_math_fit.reason_binary_count_is_zero: All ReLU phases are fixed before the selected cell is expressed as affine inequalities.
sart_phase_projection_math_fit.sart_compression_target: Binary sign variables for unfixed absolute-value or unstable-ReLU relations.
sart_phase_projection_math_fit.structural_overlap: NONE: a fixed sign turns each absolute value into plus or minus its linear expression; retaining an unknown sign reintroduces a nonconvex MIP relation.
sart_phase_projection_math_fit.performance_conclusion: SART does not reduce the affine delta stream, triangular expansion, selected target CSR, objective, or model construction that forms the only natural block large enough to pay the gap.

other_public_method_census.method: Out of the Shadows / CORA set-based falsification
other_public_method_census.closest_root_mechanism: Choose a deterministic zonotope support corner from the sign of a linear objective and execute the concrete network on it.
other_public_method_census.disposition: The root rule is the already closed analytic support-corner class; the complete algorithm proceeds through input or ReLU splitting. Published competition totals do not isolate root-only successes on the eight ACT targets, and concrete point execution is prohibited for candidate search.
Input or activation branch-and-bound, domain clipping, and bound tightening.
SDP or Lagrangian relaxation coupled to backward bound propagation and dual optimization; it yields certificate bounds rather than an ACT-replayable primal input.
DPLL(T) or CDCL activation decisions, LP abstraction, and attack paths.
Explicit multi-ReLU splitting in a branch-and-bound tree.

other_public_method_census.method: NNV, nnenum, and PyRAT exact reachability
other_public_method_census.disposition: Star or zonotope reachability coupled to ReLU or input splitting and region enumeration; some paths also begin with sampling.
Sampling, PGD or attack, and cache-dependent candidate search.
A different barrier-certificate problem using boundary-region enumeration, random initial points, and SMT or optimization.

other_public_method_census.method: Sound Verification of Deployed Neural Networks
other_public_method_census.disposition: Floating-point execution error envelopes for sound SAFE bounds, not a new counterexample primal source.
Node search, global lemma cache, DPLL or branch-and-bound, dual certificates, iterative refinement, and no verified production implementation evidence.

complexity_cross_check.fact: The 2025 COLT paper proves neural network verification coNP-hard for a general class of input domains and excludes constant-factor polynomial-time approximation of the relevant maximum in that setting.
complexity_cross_check.interpretation: This supports why public exact methods retain combinatorial or intractable machinery; it does not prove these particular fixed400 instances impossible.

gate_decision.reason: SART is statically inadmissible and has zero overlap with the current binary-free LP and its performance bottleneck; every other identified public method is either a closed local class, a prohibited method, a SAFE-only method, or lacks target-family primal evidence.
